components.name: wsl

components.name: nvidia-driver

pinned.note: GPU-passthrough-capable driver; exact version tracks the host

components.provisioned_by: operator; provision verifies nvidia-smi works inside WSL

components.name: cuda-toolkit
components.notes: No native CUDA toolkit on Windows. The apt package ships a gcc wrapper that handles the Ubuntu 24.04 gcc-13 default.

components.name: wsl-build-tools
components.notes: python3-venv is absent and pip must be invoked as `/usr/bin/python3 -m pip ... --user --break-system-packages` (bare pip3 had a broken SSL path on this host).

components.notes: Current llama.cpp dropped the standalone llama-cli target; the spot-check uses `llama-bench -o json`. sm_75 = Turing / RTX 2070 SUPER.

components.name: ollama-models

known_manual_steps: Install the NVIDIA Windows driver with WSL GPU support (operator).
wsl --install -d Ubuntu-24.04 on a machine without WSL (operator).
One `sudo apt-get install` inside WSL for build-essential + nvidia-cuda-toolkit + jq.
Accept Ollama installer UAC prompt if winget is unavailable.

One-time: configure Cline via its VS Code UI (provider Ollama, base URL http://localhost:11434, model qwen2.5-coder:7b-instruct-q4_K_M, auto-approve off), then copy providers.json + global-settings.json into provision/config/ and commit them as templates. Thereafter step 50 copies them automatically.
